Arms and armour of Age I. Hide cut and stitched over bone plates, the dress of the first hunters and the Telling singers' guards.
Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund knàim. 7 armour points in all (helmet 1, chest 3, legs 2, boots 1), toughness 0, durability x8. Made from bone plates and leather; Age I.
Arms and armour of Age II. Beaten copper over hide, the first metal of the herders and the cairn builders.
Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund uma. 10 armour points in all (helmet 2, chest 4, legs 3, boots 1), toughness 0, durability x11. Made from copper ingots; Age II.
Arms and armour of Age III. Bronze with red and blue enamel studs in the curving style of the island smiths.
Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund krèuma. 12 armour points in all (helmet 2, chest 5, legs 4, boots 1), toughness 0, durability x14. Made from bronze ingots; Age III.
Arms and armour of Age IV. Rings of iron linked by hand, the road-warden's coat in the age of kings.
Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund iarund. 15 armour points in all (helmet 2, chest 6, legs 5, boots 2), toughness 0, durability x17. Made from iron ingots; Age IV.
Arms and armour of Age V. Plate and blade of true steel, the first gear of the mills, the rails and the early cities. Sword, axe and spear start here.
Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund kruoid. 19 armour points in all (helmet 3, chest 7, legs 6, boots 3), toughness 1, durability x24. Made from steel ingots; Age V.
Arms and armour of Age VI. Layers of woven fibre under a painted steel pot, made for the wars of the power grid. Its weapon tier is tempered steel.

Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund snàitlech. 20 armour points in all (helmet 3, chest 8, legs 6, boots 3), toughness 1.5, knockback resistance 5%, durability x28. Made from ballistic weave; Age VI.
Arms and armour of Age VII. Ceramic tiles in a carbon twill: light, hard and cold, the armour of the digital age.

Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund kriadach. 24 armour points in all (helmet 4, chest 9, legs 7, boots 4), toughness 2.5, knockback resistance 5%, durability x36. Made from ceramic plates; Age VII.
Arms and armour of Age Rodos. An alloy of teal and gold, worked only since the Delivered Collection landed at Rodos.

Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund kumask. 26 armour points in all (helmet 4, chest 10, legs 8, boots 4), toughness 3.5, knockback resistance 10%, durability x46. Made from Rodos alloy ingots; Age Rodos.
Arms and armour of Age Rodos. A pale lattice of star-metal with cold light in the seams, made after Rodos and by no maker the record names.

Four-piece armour set: Klogaid, Broildech, Kas, Bòtund riondag. 30 armour points in all (helmet 5, chest 11, legs 9, boots 5), toughness 4.5, knockback resistance 15%, durability x60. Made from star lattice; Age Rodos.
